ModMetaData.name: 钢筋混凝土重型桥梁 / Reinforced Concrete Heavy Bridge
ModMetaData.author: WhiteGiverMa
ModMetaData.description:
研究「重型桥梁」与「混凝土」后，用钢筋混凝土建造重型桥梁。默认每格消耗14个钢筋混凝土，其他特性和贴图沿用奥德赛原版重型桥梁。
选项 → Mod 设置 → 钢筋混凝土重型桥梁：可调整每格材料用量、恢复默认，并选择放置建筑时自动补原版钢铁重型桥梁或钢筋混凝土重型桥梁，材料预览同步切换。还可将当前存档所有已加载地图上的本模组桥梁转为原版重型桥梁。卸载前请先备份存档、执行转换并另存，再停用模组；其他存档需分别转换。
Requires Harmony, Odyssey and Fortifications - Industrial. Research Heavy bridges and Concrete to build heavy bridges using 14 reinforced concrete per cell by default. Reuses vanilla heavy-bridge properties and textures. Material cost is adjustable in Mod Settings. Optional Replace Stuff integration lets automatic heavy bridges and their material previews use steel or reinforced concrete; existing plans are preserved. Settings also provide a confirmed conversion to vanilla heavy bridges before removal. Back up and save the converted game before disabling the mod; convert other saves separately.
封面为程序化绘制的示意图，游戏内仍使用原版桥梁贴图。Preview illustration is generated from original geometric artwork; in-game bridges use vanilla textures.
